## History

Bentley served as the pastor of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for eighteen years, remaining a widower throughout his time there despite the congregation's hopes for his remarriage. During his tenure, he was noted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for his lack of imagination. In the preceding February, he officially resigned his charge and departed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) amid the regrets of his congregation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)_
